scripts.dev: npm run build -w @amadeus/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @amadeus/shared" "npm run dev -w @amadeus/server" "npm run dev -w @amadeus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amadeus/shared && npm run build -w @amadeus/server && npm run build -w @amadeus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @amadeus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @amadeus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @amadeus/server && npm run typecheck -w @amadeus/web
